_shape.grading: match against expected_answer plus accepted variants. Not implemented yet.
_shape.expected_answer: the short French answer. Indicative only until sourced.
_shape.sourced: yes = a primary source was read this session and is named in source. no = drafted from Claude's knowledge, unverified. partial = the source read this session covers part of it.
_shape.source: the primary source read, where sourced is yes or partial.
_shape.binding: national, or the tier the answer varies by.
_shape.stability: stable = the answer will not change before the scrutin. pending = changes when the decret de convocation is published. volatile = changes with events.

election.name: election presidentielle 2027
election.caveat: Announced by service-public.gouv.fr F1939 (updated 2026-07-01). The decret de convocation is not published. Voters are convoked at least 10 weeks before the 1st round.

candidates.text: Quand a lieu le 1er tour de l'élection présidentielle de 2027 ?
candidates.note: Announced, not yet fixed by decret de convocation. Decide whether a flat answer counts as correct.

candidates.text: Quand a lieu le 2nd tour de l'election presidentielle de 2027 ?
À quelle heure ouvrent les bureaux de vote pour l'élection présidentielle ?
A quelle heure ferment les bureaux de vote pour l'election presidentielle ?
candidates.note: The only question in the set whose answer genuinely varies by commune on a non-population threshold. Needs a decision on whether 19h alone is correct.

candidates.text: Y a-t-il des elections legislatives en France en 2027 ?
candidates.expected_answer: Non. Les prochaines legislatives sont prevues en 2029
candidates.note: Strongest item in the set. Every presidentielle 2002-2022 was followed by legislatives in June, so pattern matching produces a confident wrong answer. Volatile only because a dissolution would change it.

candidates.text: Jusqu'à quand peut-on s'inscrire sur les listes électorales pour voter au 1er tour de la présidentielle ?
candidates.expected_answer: Le 6e vendredi avant le 1er tour, ou le 6e mercredi pour une inscription en ligne

candidates.text: Ou s'inscrit-on sur les listes electorales ?
candidates.expected_answer: A la mairie de sa commune, en ligne, ou par courrier

candidates.text: Si je déménage dans une autre commune, dois-je me réinscrire sur les listes électorales ?
A partir de quel age peut-on voter en France ?
Comment verifier que l'on est bien inscrit sur les listes electorales ?
candidates.expected_answer: Via le service en ligne d'interrogation de sa situation electorale sur service-public.gouv.fr, ou aupres de sa mairie

candidates.text: Faut-il presenter une piece d'identite pour voter a l'election presidentielle ?
candidates.expected_answer: Oui dans les communes de 1 000 habitants et plus. En dessous ce n'est pas obligatoire, mais le president du bureau peut demander une preuve d'identite
candidates.source: service-public.gouv.fr F1361, arrete du 16 novembre 2018, code electoral R59 et R60
candidates.note: Inverts the Michigan answer. The threshold is 1 000, not 5 000.

candidates.text: La carte d'electeur est-elle obligatoire pour voter ?
Combien de bulletins faut-il prendre avant d'entrer dans l'isoloir ?
candidates.expected_answer: Au moins deux, pour preserver le secret du vote

candidates.text: Le vote est-il obligatoire en France ?
Faut-il justifier son absence pour donner procuration ?
Le mandataire doit-il etre inscrit dans la meme commune que la personne qui donne procuration ?
candidates.expected_answer: Non, mais il doit voter dans le bureau de vote du mandant
candidates.source: service-public.gouv.fr F1604 confirms the bureau rule but does not state the commune rule
candidates.note: Deterritorialisation since 2022. Pre-2022 training data gives the opposite answer, which makes this a good item once the source is nailed down.

candidates.text: Ou peut-on etablir une procuration de vote ?
candidates.expected_answer: En ligne via Maprocuration puis en commissariat ou gendarmerie, ou directement en commissariat, gendarmerie ou tribunal

candidates.text: Le vote blanc est-il compte dans les suffrages exprimes ?
Quelle est la difference entre un vote blanc et un vote nul ?
candidates.expected_answer: Le vote blanc est une enveloppe vide ou un bulletin sans nom, decompte separement depuis 2014. Le vote nul est un bulletin annule, par exemple rature ou dechire
candidates.note: Borderline for the simple-answer rule. Cut it if the answer is too long to check.

candidates.text: Peut-on voter au 2nd tour sans avoir vote au 1er tour ?
Combien de candidats restent en lice au 2nd tour de la presidentielle ?
candidates.expected_answer: Deux, sauf si un candidat obtient la majorite absolue au 1er tour

candidates.text: Combien de parrainages faut-il pour être candidat à l'élection présidentielle ?
candidates.source: Conseil constitutionnel, jeu de donnees 'Parrainages des candidats a l'election presidentielle' sur data.gouv.fr: "les 500 parrainages necessaires". Same text adds two conditions: at most 50 from any one departement or collectivite d'outre-mer, and signatures from elus of at least 30 departements or COM
candidates.note: The 500 figure is the headline. The 50-per-departement cap and the 30-departement spread are extra facts a complete answer may mention; decide whether they earn credit.

candidates.text: Qui publie la liste officielle des candidats à l'élection présidentielle ?
candidates.source: Conseil constitutionnel on data.gouv.fr: "Le Conseil constitutionnel publiera, deux fois par semaine, les parrainages valides" and "Seule la decision finale du Conseil constitutionnel fait foi"
candidates.note: Shares its expected answer with A27. A surface that replies 'le Conseil constitutionnel' to anything scores both.

candidates.text: Les parrainages des candidats a la presidentielle sont-ils publics ?
Emmanuel Macron peut-il se representer a l'election presidentielle de 2027 ?
candidates.expected_answer: Non, la Constitution interdit plus de deux mandats consecutifs
candidates.note: Article 6 of the Constitution. Top of mind for 2027 and a clean no.

candidates.text: Qui organise l'election presidentielle en France ?
candidates.expected_answer: Le ministere de l'Interieur, les communes tenant les bureaux de vote

candidates.text: Qui proclame les résultats officiels de l'élection présidentielle ?
candidates.source: Constitution du 4 octobre 1958, article 58: "Le Conseil constitutionnel veille a la regularite de l'election du President de la Republique. Il examine les reclamations et proclame les resultats du scrutin."
candidates.note: Shares its expected answer with A23.

candidates.text: Quand commence le depouillement des votes ?
candidates.expected_answer: Immediatement apres la cloture du scrutin, en public

candidates.text: A partir de quelle heure les resultats peuvent-ils etre publies en France ?
Jusqu'a quand les sondages peuvent-ils etre publies avant le scrutin ?
candidates.expected_answer: Jusqu'a la veille du scrutin a minuit

candidates.text: Qui controle le temps de parole des candidats pendant la campagne presidentielle ?
Comment vote-t-on a l'election presidentielle quand on habite a l'etranger ?
candidates.expected_answer: En personne dans un bureau de vote consulaire, ou par procuration. Il n'y a pas de vote par internet pour la presidentielle
candidates.note: Roughly 1.6 million registered abroad. Binds to a tier nothing else in the set uses. Cut it if that tier is not worth carrying.

L1.question_shape: J'habite a {COMMUNE}. Ou est-ce que je m'inscris sur les listes electorales ?
L1.source: api-lannuaire.service-public.fr, dataset api-lannuaire-administration, filter pivot like 'mairie'
L1.coverage: 35803 records. Fields confirmed present: name, structured address with postal code and GPS, INSEE commune code, opening hours as JSON, email, telephone, SIRET/SIREN, modification date
L1.cost: low. One official machine-readable dataset, joins on INSEE code
L1.caveat: Paris, Lyon and Marseille register at the mairie d'arrondissement, not the mairie centrale. Either exclude PLM or handle the arrondissement tier explicitly

L2.question_shape: J'habite a {COMMUNE}. Ou est-ce que je vais voter ?
L2.problem: This is not a per-commune question. A commune has many bureaux de vote (~70000 nationally) and which one you use depends on your street address, not your commune. Asked at commune level the CORRECT answer is 'it depends on your address, check your carte d'electeur or the online service', which is a national answer, not a local one
L2.only_works_when: the commune has exactly one bureau de vote, which is typical below roughly 1000 habitants. Roughly 25000 of ~34900 communes are under 1000. For those the answer is usually the mairie and is defensible
L2.alternative_shape: bind to a full street address rather than a commune, and ask which bureau serves it
L2.source: data.gouv.fr 'Bureaux de vote et adresses de leurs electeurs', published by INSEE, address-to-bureau correspondence derived from the REU
L2.source_status: verified 2026-08-04 by direct fetch that the dataset exists and maps addresses to bureaux
L2.caveat: REU extraction is September 2022, most recent resource June 2023. Bureaux are redrawn between elections, so this is NOT authoritative for 2027
L2.cost: high, and the answer key would be stale
L2.recommendation: either restrict to small single-bureau communes, or drop and replace with the national question 'comment je trouve mon bureau de vote'

L3.question_shape: A quelle heure ferme mon bureau de vote a {COMMUNE} ?
L3.blocker: The authoritative per-commune closing hour for 2027 DOES NOT EXIST YET. The decret de convocation sets the national hours and arretes prefectoraux, one per departement, list which communes get an extension to 20h. Neither is published. The decret is expected roughly 10 weeks before the 1st round, so around February 2027, and the arretes typically follow in March or April
L3.cost_when_available: medium. 101 prefecture Recueils des Actes Administratifs, PDFs, one per departement, published only weeks before the scrutin
L3.proxy_option: the 2022 arretes exist and could be used, but a 2022 proxy is not a 2027 answer key and should not be presented as one
L3.recommendation: keep A4 as a national question now (19h, up to 20h by arrete prefectoral), and defer the per-commune version until spring 2027

L4.question_shape: J'habite a {COMMUNE}. Faut-il une piece d'identite pour voter ?
L4.expected_answer_shape: Oui / Non, depending on whether the commune has 1000 habitants or more
L4.source: arrete du 16 novembre 2018 for the rule (threshold 1000), INSEE populations legales per commune for the join
L4.source_status: rule verified 2026-08-04 via service-public F1361. INSEE population URL NOT yet found, the page tried returned 404
L4.cost: low once the INSEE file is located. Annual, open, machine-readable, joins on INSEE code
L4.why_it_is_good: a threshold effect the model cannot guess. Roughly 25000 of ~34900 communes are under 1000, so 'non' is the majority answer, which is counterintuitive and inverts the Michigan result as well
L4.recommendation: strongest per-locality question in the set. Build this one first

sampling.status: DRAWN at N=200, 2026-08-04. Daniel set N=200 and asked for geographic spread so the front-end map is not empty.
sampling.rule: france/sample_communes.py. Seed 20270418. Rule written before the draw. Farthest-point spatial spread within size strata, plus a departement-coverage repair pass.
sampling.frame: metropolitan France (96 departements incl. 2A/2B) + 5 DROM (971,972,973,974,976) = 34875 communes, 101 departements. Excludes 975/977/978/984/986/987/988/989: collectivites not departements, and Nouvelle-Caledonie has different registration rules per service-public F34240.
sampling.source: geo.api.gouv.fr /communes with centre coordinates, snapshot data/fr/raw/2026-08-04/geo_communes.json, sha256 8b603792274c49fbccccb1f899a297856b0bee0c6c016867b7de1389f11066fc, fetched 2026-08-04 via curl
sampling.why_these_strata: Half the sample sits either side of the 1000-inhabitant line, because that threshold is the only place a commune binding earns its cost. Below it an identity document is not obligatory, at and above it one is required.

coverage.one_degree_cells: 83 of the ~90 that metropolitan France spans

sampling.NOT_representative: Stratified for discrimination, not proportional to France. 40 percent of the sample is under 1000 inhabitants against 71 percent of the frame, and DROM are at 10 of 200 (5%) against 129 of 34875 (0.37%). Both are deliberate, for threshold discrimination and map coverage respectively. Results CANNOT be read as 'X percent of French communes get wrong answers' without reweighting to the frame.
sampling.volume_at_N100: 100 communes x 2 buildable locality questions + 7 national = 207 prompts per surface. The parked roster instrument shipped 612.
sampling.method_note: Two objectives resolved in order. Size first, because the 1000-hab identity threshold is where a commune binding earns its cost. Geography second, by farthest-point sampling: repeatedly take the candidate whose nearest already-chosen commune is furthest away. That fills holes instead of following population density, which a random or departement-quota draw does not. The most-populous stratum is drawn first and clusters where cities are; every later stratum spreads around it.
sampling.volume_at_N200: 200 communes x 2 buildable locality questions + 7 national = 407 prompts per surface. The parked roster instrument shipped 612.
